title: Prélude à l'après-midi d'un faune
notes: Languid flute-led tone poem after Mallarmé; hazy harmony, form dissolved into colour.

title: Suite bergamasque
notes: Four piano dances after Verlaine and Watteau; floating, moonlit Clair de lune at centre.

title: La mer
notes: Three symphonic sea sketches: misty dawn, wave-play, then a storming wind-and-sea dialogue.

title: Préludes
notes: Twenty-four piano pictures, titles at the end; whole-tone and pentatonic colour.
